about.intro: Solo + Us is a private, judgment-free way to keep track of your activity over the long term.

judgmentFree.title: Judgment-free
judgmentFree.body: Solo + Us doesn't rate your activity as high, low, good, or bad.

noStreakPressure.title: No streak pressure
noStreakPressure.body: There's no streak counter and nothing to keep up.

lowFriction.title: Low friction
lowFriction.body: Recording a moment takes one tap — pick a type, and it's logged with the current time.

privacyFirst.title: Privacy first
privacyFirst.body: Your data is sensitive, so it stays on this device by default.

longTermData.title: Long-term data
longTermData.body: Built for keeping records over years, not just building a short-term habit.

privacyFacts.encryptedOnDevice: Your activity data is encrypted and stored on this device
privacyFacts.noServer: We don't run a server that receives your activity data
privacyFacts.healthConnectSubset: If you turn on Health Connect sync, the date/time and whether protection was used are also written there
privacyFacts.exportsNotEncrypted: Files you export are not encrypted
privacyFacts.noAdvertising: Your data is never used for advertising
privacyFacts.noAnalytics: No analytics or crash reporting SDKs in this version

safetyExportLocationNotice.android: Before replacing anything, you'll be asked to choose a folder to save a safety backup of your current data.
safetyExportLocationNotice.ios: Before replacing anything, a safety backup of your current data will be saved in Solo + Us's private storage on this device. It isn't visible in the Files app, but — unlike the app's own database — it's included in this device's iCloud/iTunes backup as an unencrypted file for as long as it remains on this device.

deleteData.confirmCaption: Every activity on this device will be deleted immediately.
deleteData.androidCaption: Records already sent to Health Connect will be deleted there too, over time. If you close Solo + Us before that finishes, deletion pauses and picks up again the next time you open the app. If you uninstall Solo + Us before it finishes, those records will remain in Health Connect.

deleteData.allDataDeletedMessage: Every activity has been permanently deleted.

activityDetails.caption: Values you have already recorded are always shown, even if turned off. Protection is also always shown for partnered activities. Setting a default fills it in automatically when you use Quick Record.

hideAppPreview.alwaysHidesCaption: Solo + Us always hides your records from the app switcher — this can't be turned off.
hideAppPreview.androidLegacySideEffect: On this version of Android, that also blocks screenshots and screen recordings as a side effect.
hideAppPreview.androidExplanation: On Android 13 and later, the Recent Apps preview is replaced with a blank screen, and screenshots and screen recordings are allowed unless you turn on Block Screenshots. On Android 12 and earlier, hiding the Recent Apps preview requires blocking screenshots and screen recordings too, so Block Screenshots can't be turned off there.
hideAppPreview.iosExplanation: On iOS, the app switcher preview is blurred. Screenshots and screen recordings are allowed unless you turn on Block Screenshots.
